free.text: 14-day trial; CSV import limit differs by page

subs.math: The Basic price for 1,000 subscribers and 4,000 emails a month.
Starter: $100 + $20 × (5,000 − 3,000) ÷ 1,000 steps, rounded up = $140 a month.
Starter: $100 + $20 × (10,000 − 3,000) ÷ 1,000 steps, rounded up = $240 a month.
Advanced: $300 + $40 × (50,000 − 20,000) ÷ 5,000 steps, rounded up = $540 a month.
